thread:
rachel: Noticed SCIM errors right after last night's IdP cert swap + automation run. Getting KMS Decrypt AccessDenied and immediate 403s from the SCIM endpoint. Some groups lost members briefly. Logs: 
```
2026-04-02T22:14:12Z scim-sync error="AccessDenied: kms:Decrypt denied" principal=arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/scim-provisioner
2026-04-02T22:14:14Z scim-sync http 403 POST /Groups -> {"error":"forbidden"}
```
Can someone pick this up? @ops-lead @lia-security

anil: I'm oncall. quick questions: did infra-automation touch KMS key policies or rekey keys during the deploy? Also which principal is used by the runtime to decrypt tokens?

rachel: provisioner runs as `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/scim-provisioner`. Deploy id infra-deploy-20260402-22 shows IdP cert rotate and then a pipeline stage `policy-hardening`. I see a CloudTrail PutKeyPolicy at 22:13:58 by infra-automation.

infra-automation-bot: [AUDIT] event=PutKeyPolicy user=infra-automation key=alias/scim-provisioner time=2026-04-02T22:13:58Z change=deny-external-principals id=pkp-9012

lia-security: please check aws kms get-key-policy and aws iam get-role-policy for scim-provisioner. My hunch: the hardening job added a deny or removed the role from the allow list. Also check for UpdateAssumeRolePolicy events.

anil: pulling policies now. Found a new Deny in key policy that introduced a NotPrincipal whitelist which omitted the scim-provisioner role. Also an inline role policy tightened conditions on kms actions at 22:13:55Z. That explains the AccessDenied.

ops-lead: immediate mitigations: 1) revert the key policy change to restore kms:Decrypt for scim-provisioner, 2) increase SCIM deprovision grace to 72h and pause prune jobs, 3) disable the `policy-hardening` stage until we add preflight checks. Rachel can you apply 1 and 2?

rachel: applying key policy rollback now and bumping grace. Commands I used: 
```bash
aws kms put-key-policy --key-id alias/scim-provisioner --policy file://allow-scim-provisioner.json
kubectl set env deployment/scim-provisioner SCIM_DEPROV_GRACE_HOURS=72 -n infra
```

lia-security: also open an audit alert: any future PutKeyPolicy must diff against a baseline and raise a PagerDuty if it removes principals used by runtime services. We'll need a small lambda watcher for that. Add the alert and gate to the runbook.

anil: after patch, we're seeing successful decrypts and 200s on SCIM calls at 22:18:07Z. Sample: 
```
2026-04-02T22:18:07Z scim-sync http 200 PATCH /Users/998 user=charlie@example.com action=update
```
Ops looking stable. Keep monitoring for role flapping.

ops-lead: root cause summary: automation applied an overly strict key policy during an IdP rotation. Remediation plan: - require code owner + security approval for infra-automation PRs that touch kms key policies - add preflight validation step to rotation pipeline that verifies runtime principals are preserved - CI test that runs `aws kms get-key-policy` and fails if essential principals are removed - update runbook with re-encrypt/rollback steps and ownership map - classify infra-automation as high-risk in vuln board.

lia-security: additional follow-ups: create PagerDuty rule for PutKeyPolicy diffs, create an internal lint that flags NotPrincipal/NotAction patterns, and add a short blameless postmortem template. I'll own the gating work.

rachel: note: we did not need to re-encrypt tokens in this case because we rolled back policy. if a rekey had completed we'd need to re-encrypt token blobs and rotate secrets in Vault — add that to the runbook. Jack please add re-encrypt helper snippets (aws kms encrypt/decrypt patterns).

infra-automation-bot: [INFO] policy-hardening job disabled by ops-lead at 2026-04-02T22:25:12Z pending gating changes.

sre-bot: [INCIDENT] service=scim-provisioner incident=INC-2026-0402-03 status=mitigated mitigated_by=rachel mitigated_at=2026-04-02T22:25:40Z runbook=https://redwood.runbooks/internal/scim-provisioning-triage :white_check_mark:

ops-lead: assign owners: @lia-security gate owner, @anil postmortem draft, @rachel runbook updates + logs attached, @infra-automation add CI test. ETA EOD. Thanks team.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from anil, :eyes: from lia-security)
